_source: Yahoo league 441056 FANTAZY FULZBOL — Scoring & Settings page, entered by hand while Fantasy Sports API access is under review.
name: FANTAZY FULZBOL
_roster: Yahoo lists: QB, WR, RB, TE, W/T, W/R, K, DEF, BN x5, IR x2. Note TWO separate flex slots with different eligibility, not one combined flex.
_divisions: Two divisions of eight, read off the Yahoo standings page. Division matters for scheduling (teams play inside the division more often) and, in most Yahoo setups, for playoff seeding.
_teams: waiverPriority is the rolling waiver order shown on the standings page. Lower number claims first. Ours is 13 of 16 — near the back, which is a real constraint on the streaming strategy: we will lose most contested claims and should target players nobody else wants yet rather than the obvious add.
_schedule: Only weeks entered here are treated as the REAL schedule. Anything absent is filled by a division-aware round robin purely so the season simulation has something to run on — it is labelled as estimated in the app and must never be read as Yahoo's actual pairings. Add weeks as you read them off Yahoo; each week is a list of [home, away] name pairs.
_waivers: Weekly rolling list based on standings — NOT FAAB. Continuous processing. faabBudget is therefore unused for bidding; waiver priority governs claims.

scoring._passing: 0.5/completion and 0.5/first down are the two categories generic rankings ignore entirely, and together they are worth ~19 pts/game to an elite QB.
scoring._rushing: 0.2 per carry rewards volume backs beyond their yardage.
scoring._receiving: Half PPR, but the 0.5 first-down bonus pushes possession receivers close to full PPR in practice.
scoring._misc: CORRECTED from the manager's reading of the Yahoo tables: return yards score NOTHING for RB/WR/TE, and the QB line (10 yds/pt) is dead weight because quarterbacks do not return kicks. The only live return-yard rule in this league is the Defense/Special Teams one — 10 yards per point, i.e. def_ret_yd 0.1, plus +1 at 30 yards. Leave ret_yd at 0: setting it non-zero would silently inflate every skill player.
scoring._kicking: Only sub-20 misses are penalised; longer misses cost nothing.
scoring._defense: Notably inflated vs Yahoo defaults: 2/sack (vs 1), 16 for a shutout (vs 10). Defenses are worth more here than in a standard league.
scoring._bonuses: INTERPRETATION FLAG: Yahoo shows these as '10 yards per point; 1 points at 50 yards'. Read as a flat +1 once the player crosses the threshold in a game, ON TOP of the per-yard rate. If it actually means something else, change or delete these entries — nothing else depends on them.
